classification: Exact finite mathematical verification; neither a general proof nor a speed benchmark.

finite_worlds_and_cuts.scope: Every odd B from 3 through max_B; literal S_B versus independent Eratosthenes.
finite_worlds_and_cuts.window_scope: Full safe odd interval, final 15 odd addresses, central up-to-15 odd addresses; duplicate windows removed.
finite_worlds_and_cuts.cut_identity: For c_prime<=c: (c_prime OR u)=(c OR u) iff (c-c_prime)*(1-u)=0.

first_private_prime_square.scope: Every prime p through the requested world bound; shadows A_q={2q,3q,...}.
first_private_prime_square.claim_checked: p^2 is the first address of A_p not covered by smaller-prime shadows.

factorizations_and_layers.factorization_scope: All integers n from 1 through 10000; factors are checked against an independent sieve.
factorizations_and_layers.geometric_model: Finite nonnegative exponent vectors over a fixed prime basis; 1 is the all-zero vector.
factorizations_and_layers.layer_identity: For last basis prime q and k>=0: {n/q^k: n is in the fixed-basis world up to X, exponent_q(n)=k} equals the smaller-basis world with bound floor(X/q^k).
factorizations_and_layers.interpretation_scope: Exact illustration of slices and projections; this exponent world is distinct from S_B.

strong_pseudoprime_2047.scope: A single-base strong pseudoprime example; this does not show failure of every multi-base or bounded deterministic Miller-Rabin variant.
